'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Mike Richards DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Username:''' Mr007 Agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
